description: Plan 261009 Phase 2: newer log folders that hold no CLI version do not hide an older CLI run. The newest folder has no kiro.log, the next holds only IDE lines, the third holds the pair unescaped on a plain line (2.29.0), the oldest holds 2.28.0 escaped. Two decoy folders that are not timestamp-named sort above all of them and hold 2.99.0 (`backup-old`, and `20261231T235900000-old`, a timestamp prefix with a suffix): both must be ignored, otherwise `> 2.29` would fire. The reader takes 2.29.0, the first match in the newest folder that has one, so > 2.27 and > 2.28 fire and > 2.29 does not (the oldest folder's 2.28.0 would fire only > 2.27). A claude-code control entry fires, which shows the manifest ran.
